candidate.suite_totals: median_total_seconds and per_phase.median_seconds = sum over workloads of the workload medians; peak RSS = mean over workloads

incumbent.suite_totals: median_total_seconds and per_phase.median_seconds = sum over workloads of the workload medians; peak RSS = mean over workloads

stock.suite_totals: median_total_seconds and per_phase.median_seconds = sum over workloads of the workload medians; peak RSS = mean over workloads

candidate_vs_incumbent.aggregate: suite: mean over workloads of each workload's median paired value; wins = rounds whose own-workload value is > 0

candidate_vs_stock.aggregate: suite: mean over workloads of each workload's median paired value; wins = rounds whose own-workload value is > 0

correctness.oracle: per workload, as a single-workload job: per round stock-read snapshot equality, restore manifest == stock restore, rotating 1/5 check --read-data-subset of the pruned repo, ls --json parsed equality; warm-up full oracle of every arm on every workload

reasons: reference evidence cannot promote; promotion requires 12 fresh rounds
why: reference evidence cannot promote; promotion requires 12 fresh rounds

measurement.M: mean over phases of phase peak RSS
measurement.T: sum of phase wall seconds (per workload round)
measurement.rss: wait4() ru_maxrss of the bwrap monitor whose only child is restic (namespace PID 1): max(monitor ~11 MiB, restic VmHWM at exit)
measurement.storage: tmpfs for corpus, repositories, restore targets and restic temp/cache
measurement.time: parent-side time.monotonic() around the sandboxed process (includes ~8 ms bwrap setup, identical for all arms)
